title: Godrej Stella Codebase
description: Comprehensive reference document for Godrej Stella, Indonesia's leading air care and home fragrance brand manufactured by PT Megasari Makmur (Godrej Consumer Products).

brand_overview.category: Home Care, Air Fresheners, & Fabric Care
brand_overview.philosophy: Bringing natural, long-lasting, and refreshing fragrances into everyday living spaces, ensuring every room and vehicle feels welcoming and odor-free.

product_lines.name: Stella Matic Room Air Fresheners
product_lines.features: Battery-operated automatic timer functionality with adjustable spray intervals. Delivers consistent, signature natural fragrances over 30 to 60 days.
product_lines.applications: Ideal for living rooms, offices, and larger indoor spaces.

product_lines.name: Stella All-In-One Air Freshener
product_lines.features: Economical and practical solid air freshener infused with natural oils. Effectively eliminates unpleasant odors.
product_lines.applications: Versatile use in cars, bedrooms, bathrooms, and closets.

product_lines.name: Stella Pocket / Bathroom Freshener
product_lines.features: Slim, space-saving design that provides up to 30 days of continuous freshness. Contains highly concentrated perfume oils.
product_lines.applications: Specifically formulated for bathrooms, toilets, and small cupboards to neutralize damp and foul odors.

product_lines.name: Stella Car Perfume & Daily Freshness
product_lines.features: Sleek liquid and gel formulations with adjustable scent intensity. 'After Smoke' variants contain specific odor-neutralizing technology.
product_lines.applications: Automotive interiors, easily attaching to AC vents for uniform fragrance distribution.

product_lines.name: Stella Fresh + Protect Fabric Spray
product_lines.features: Dual-action formula acts as a fabric freshener and disinfectant. Kills 99.9% of germs while removing trapped odors from textiles without leaving stains.
product_lines.applications: Sofas, curtains, carpets, bed linens, and clothing.
